question: In a code language, ‘GATHER’ is written as '20-26-7-19-22-9' and ‘DISPERSE’ is written as '23- 18-8-11-22-9-8-22'. How will ‘CONSTRAINT’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is as follows:

**The alphabets are coded as the positional value of opposite alphabets.**

The word GATHER is written as '20-26-7-19-22-9'
